Iran Invites Indian Leaders for Ayatollah Khamenei's Funeral

Iran has invited several Indian political leaders, including those from the Congress and BJP parties, to the funeral of its late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The invitations come as Tehran prepares for the ceremony, with security measures being planned to avoid past crowd surge incidents. The attendance of Indian representatives is noted, with some reports indicating Prime Minister Modi is unlikely to attend.
